inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: At the time of the inspection, 2 children's files reviewed did not have their physician's inforamation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Water Activity Permission (26 TAC §744.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Does not include Advertising or Violence: At the time of the inspection, a classroom was seen playing the fortnite video This was brought into compliance when the caregiver turned the game off during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Does not include Advertising or Violence (26 TAC §744.2007(b)(5))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: At the time of this inspection, the annual sanitation report had expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §744.2501(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: During the January 2025 fire drill the  staff and children were not able to safely exit the building within three minutes. This was corrected at inspection when a drill was conducted and everyone was able to exit under 3 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §744.3559(1))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: The operation did not have any documentation showing the time of fire drills to ensure that they were able to exit in 3 minutes.  The staff had to call another staff during inspection to obtain this information as it was not available for review during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §744.3559(4))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired: The operation had two different types if antiseptic ointment in the first aid kit that expired in 2017 and 2022.  The director removed these from the first aid kit during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired (26 TAC §744.2753(b))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: The smoke detectors were not tested in the month of February 2025.  This was corrected at inspection when the director conducted the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §744.3619)

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector- Director or Designee Check All Detectors Monthly: The carbon monoxide detection system was not tested in the month of February 2025.   This was corrected at inspection when the director conducted the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector- Director or Designee Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §744.3757(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: The fire extinguishers were not inspected in the month of February 2025.  This was corrected at inspection when the director conducted the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §744.3607(a))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: Four classrooms had garbage accessible to children as the trash cans contained garbage in them and did not have a lid on them.  This was corrected when all four trash cans were removed from the classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §744.2507(5))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: One group of kids were observed in a classroom eating snack while watching cartoons.  This was corrected when the caregiver shut off the television.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §744.2007(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available -  Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, and Smoke Detectors: The provider did have any documentation of inspecting the carbon monoxide detectors, smoke detectors, or fire extinguishers monthly.  This was corrected at inspection when the provider completed all 3 inspections.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available -  Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, and Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §744.801(9))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Ten children's admission files were missing the following information: emergency contact address, Name, address, and telephone number of the child's physician or anemergency-care facility, and authorization to obtain emergency medical care and to transport the child for emergency medical treatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §744.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: The operation did not have children's records available for review during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §744.801(1))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Training Requirements - Original Training Certification Card or Letter in each Employee's personnel record: The operation did not have documentation of training for ten staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Original Training Certification Card or Letter in each Employee's personnel record (26 TAC §744.1331(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: Four staff did not know the children's ages or have anything to locate what the children's ages were during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §744.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns: The operation is not following the meals and snacks must follow the meal patterns established by the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP) that is administered by the Texas Department of Agriculture.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §744.2401(b))

occurrences.finding: Care Requirements for Children Younger Than 5 - Written Plan: The operation did not have a written activity plan for any of the children in care including those under 5 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Care Requirements for Children Younger Than 5 - Written Plan (26 TAC §744.2003(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements- Letter or form from the most recent licensing inspection or investigation.: The letter or form from the most recent Licensing inspection or investigation was not posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements- Letter or form from the most recent licensing inspection or investigation. (26 TAC §744.401(2))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: One staff allowed children outside on the playground without knowing who the children were left in care with at the end of his shift.  During the inspection another staff stated she was only responsible for half of the children and I was able to observe other staff outside present with the other children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §744.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Ten staff personnel files were incomplete and missing the required documents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §744.901)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: Two staff had children watching cartoons in their classrooms.  The staff shut off the televisions during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §744.2007(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance: The operation does not have the following files required at the operation:  liability insurance
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance (26 TAC §744.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation does not have a sanitation inspection on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §744.2501(a))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: There are several pieces of garbage on the playground area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §744.2507(5))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation does not have a fire inspection on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §744.3501(a))

Parents Rights
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans (26 TAC §744.501(22))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §744.2507(5))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation does not have a fire inspection on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §744.3501(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans: The operation does not have the following operational policies:  Illness and exclusion criteria; Procedures for handling medical emergencies; Procedures for parental notifications; Immunization requirements for children, including tuberculosis screening and testing if required by your regional Texas Department of State Health Services or local health authority, Permissions for Transportation, Water Activities, and Fields Trips, if applicable, Animals, Procedures for providing and applying, as needed, insect repellant and sunscreen, including what types will be used, if applicable; Procedures for parents to review and discuss with the director any questions or concerns about the policies and procedures of the operation; Procedures for parents to visit the operation at any time during your hours of operation to observe their child, program activities, the building, the premises, and equipment without having to secure prior approval; Procedures for parents to participate in the operation's activities; Procedures for parents to review a copy of the operation's most recent Licensing inspection report and how the parent may access the minimum standards online; Instructions on how a parent may contact the local Licensing office, access the Texas Abuse and Neglect Hotline, and access the HHSC website; Emergency preparedness plan; Procedures for conducting health checks, if applicable; Information on vaccine-preventable diseases for employees, unless your operation is in the home of the permit holder, the director, or a caregiver. If your operation maintains and administers unassigned epinephrine auto-injectors to use when a child in care has an emergency anaphylaxis reaction, policies for maintenance, administration, and disposal of unassigned epinephrine auto-injectors that comply with the unassigned epinephrine auto-injector requirements set by the Texas Department of State Health Services, as specified in 25 TAC Chapter 40, Subchapter C (relating to Epinephrine Auto-Injector Policies in Youth Facilities) and Texas Health and Safety Code ?773.0145. Procedures for supporting inclusive services to children with special care needs. The policy must address the requirements outlined in ?744.2009 of this chapter (relating to What are my responsibilities when planning activities for a child in care with special care needs?)
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans (26 TAC §744.501(22))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §744.2501(a))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance (26 TAC §744.801(5))
